influences.name: Astrud Gilberto
influences.context: I guess Nina [Persson] discovered Astrud Gilberto there, and, along with Peter [Svensson], they were inspired to write this song, which later turned into a disco song in the studio.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: Peter [Svensson] wasn't that into '60s pop, except for late-period The Beatles, but I know Lee Hazlewood and Nancy Sinatra were huge inspirations for our album "Life."
